widgets_values:
No models or samplers. Paste saved .safetensors paths into state_paths, one per line in playback order. The paired MP4 files must remain alongside their states. Do not list the MP4 paths.
Keep allow_cuts false to verify the parent/child sequence. The three-segment 30-second graphs already trim their overlaps; this export does not trim them again.
pad_final_frame adds exactly one final repeated frame (719 → 720 frames for the default three segments). Turn it off for exports that should preserve the original total frame count.
Queue this graph alone. Updating/restarting CRTP is safe for already saved takes. The originals remain unchanged, and failed partial exports are removed.
